desc:
🐉 Welcome to Steal a Dragon and Ride It!

How to Play:
🥚 Sneak up and steal baby dragons and Mystery Eggs from sleeping parent dragons
🏃 RUN! The parent wakes up and chases you back to the safe zone
🐣 Hatch eggs and raise babies into giant adult dragons
💰 Earn money from every dragon in your pen
🏋️ Train on your treadmill to gain Speed, and upgrade it 12 times
🐲 Ride your grown dragons to go even faster, and FLY on Legendaries!
🌋 Explore 5 worlds: Grass Hills, Fire Volcano, Ice Peaks, Storm Clouds and Shadow Realm
🌙 Every night, ALL the eggs reset, so be ready to grab the best ones!
✨ Collect all 40 dragons in the Index, buy speedy trails, and climb the leaderboards!

🎮 Supports Desktop, Console, Mobile, and Tablet players
